package.name: sensor_scan_generation
package.description: 将 Unity/SLAM 输出的世界坐标系点云 (/registered_scan, frame_id=map) 逆变换到传感器坐标系，发布局部点云 /sensor_scan (frame_id=sensor_at_scan)。 同时发布与点云时间戳对齐的里程计 /state_estimation_at_scan 和 TF map→sensor_at_scan。 原始代码来自 CMU Autonomous Exploration Development Environment (https://github.com/HongbiaoZ/autonomous_exploration_development_environment) License: BSD
